name: What is the process for getting an interior painting estimate in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting an interior painting estimate in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get an interior painting estimate in Orange County, you would typically contact us to schedule a convenient on-site consultation. During this visit, a project manager will assess the areas to be painted, discuss your specific needs and preferences regarding colors, finishes, and any necessary repairs. They will take measurements, evaluate wall conditions, and address any questions you have. Following the assessment, you will receive a detailed, transparent proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and total cost for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule an on-site consultation where a project manager will assess your home, discuss needs, take measurements, and then provide a detailed proposal.
